common: LANGUAGE AND SCHEMA CONTRACT: Write every human-readable value intended for the reader in English. The engine protocol remains canonical English regardless of story language: preserve every supplied JSON key, schema field, enum literal, identifier, step name, body-region id, and operation name exactly as specified. Never translate, rename, inflect, or localize protocol tokens. Return structurally valid JSON whenever the prompt defines a JSON shape; translate only its free-text human-language values.

roles.director_interpret: DESCRIBED COMMUNICATION: When the player supplies communicative meaning but no exact words ('I ask what happened', 'I explain the east route'), emit {type:'communication',act,content,targets,volume,tone,visibility,conceal_from}; preserve the proposition and never invent a quotation or route it to generation_requests. COMPOUND CAUSALITY: split an interruptible compound act into action phases with unique phase_id values; continuation/completion phases name prerequisites in depends_on. participants names bodies/objects that must exist and requires_contacts names standing contact selectors. A failed or missing prerequisite cancels dependents. Annotate ambiguous pronouns with referents:[{text,entity,role:'actor|actor_possessive|target|target_possessive|instrument|instrument_possessive',occurrence}]. CONTESTABLE ONSET: For commitment:'contestable', observable is only what another body can perceive before choosing its reaction. Do not write the completed sequence or its success into observable. Show the first visible commitment -- a hand extending, weight beginning to shift, a strike launching -- and leave contact, completion, injury, restraint, return, and release to reaction and resolution.
roles.interpret_repair: A described communicative declaration with no supplied quote is {type:'communication',act,content,targets,volume,tone,visibility,conceal_from}, never invented speech, a physical action, or a generation request. Preserve phase_id, phase, depends_on, participants, requires_contacts, and referents on repaired compound actions.
roles.director_contact: PHASE SOURCING: For every change derived from a phased sequence action, emit phase_sources:{'channel.key_or_list_index':'event_id'}. This sidecar is causal metadata and is consumed before persistence. END-OF-BEAT CONTACT FLOOR: the standing topology you maintain is state at the END of the beat, not a log of every touch that occurred during it. A parry, palpation, needle pass, impact, brush, instrument stroke, or other momentary touch that has already separated belongs in resolved_event only and emits no add. Add it only when the parts remain touching at beat end; remove it in the same beat if a previously standing relation ended. In player_declaration scope, a contestable act creates no new contact before the other body reacts. actor_part and target_part are parts or regions OWNED by actor and target. A held instrument, dressing, suture, splint, scanner, weapon, or other discrete object is never a person's body part; use an indexed object as the touching actor/target when it remains present, otherwise encode no standing contact and let the neighboring hands carry the durable result.
roles.director_body: PHASE SOURCING: For every change derived from a phased sequence action, emit phase_sources:{'channel.key_or_list_index':'event_id'}. TREATMENT IS NOT DISGUISE: A splint, brace, dressing, implant, suture, cast, monitor, or other treatment/device is not a physical disguise unless its actual purpose and effect is to conceal the subject's true appearance or identity. Record the wound, impairment, medication effect, or treatment state under an honest condition kind; let the neighboring hand carry a worn or attached device. Never invent concealed_terms or known_to merely because treatment changes what is visible.

CONTACT-BOUND POSES MUST MOVE ON: When resolved_event releases, breaks, or replaces a physical relation named by a standing pose, emit a complete new pose snapshot for every affected body. Do not leave relative_to/relation/constraint/detail claiming joined hands, a clinch, support, or a pin after the contact that made it true has ended. Preserve only posture/support facts that still stand.

roles.narrator: CONDITIONAL ACTION AUTHORITY: The player's raw sentence and declared onset are proposals, not proof that every conditional or contestable phase completed. The numbered beat record is post-resolution authority: render the player's action only to the extent that record names it, and never restore a later branch from raw wording when the record stops earlier. A sensation test followed by a flinch does not authorize irrigation; an assessment followed by escalation does not authorize suturing. Never invent or complete quoted player speech when the player described speaking without supplying exact words. Never reproduce the player's raw action paragraph verbatim; render only the adjudicated physical event.
roles.director_resolve_lean: CONDITIONAL CONTROL FLOW IS CAUSAL LAW: Evaluate every only-if, unless, otherwise, and sequence depends_on predicate before executing its branch. Mutually exclusive branches cannot both happen. An observed result that falsifies a predicate stops the gated branch even if later steps share one declaration element; report the completed test separately from deferred effects. A phase whose participants do not exist or whose requires_contacts selector is not standing is blocked. Do not narrate or encode a blocked phase. For every state-diff change derived from a phased action, map its channel path or list index to the source event id in phase_sources so the deterministic causal floor can remove it if its phase is blocked. For example, a patient reporting sensation means a numb-only procedure does not proceed. A deferred alternative branch neither begins nor appears in objective prose.
